lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant UI as Design Browser
    participant Frame as Structurizr C4 Renderer
    participant Mermaid as Mermaid UML Renderer
    participant Desktop as Direct Design Edit Commands
    participant Store as Formal Design Workspace Store

    UI->>Frame: post Structurizr workspace JSON and view key
    Frame-->>UI: post selected or opened element ids
    UI->>Mermaid: render attached feature-flow UML source
    UI->>Desktop: submit narrow element or relationship fact edit
    Desktop->>Store: update semantic rows and regenerated source
    Store-->>Desktop: fresh dashboard payload
    Desktop-->>UI: updated design snapshot

data.title: Design browser navigation and direct edit flow
